turns.reply: I fixed `_replace_refs` in `fastapi/_compat/v2.py` so it only treats a `"$ref"` key as a JSON Schema reference when its value is a string. Previously a property literally named `"$ref"` (whose value is a schema dict) crashed on `.split`. A quick check with an aliased `$ref` field now produces the expected OpenAPI output, and the existing schema-extra tests pass. I did not add a regression test.
